summary.text: Jason C. Buckel is a Republican member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 1B who has served since January 14, 2015, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Buckel was elected House minority leader on April 13, 2021.

For 2025-2026 Ballotpedia lists his committee assignments as the Ways and Means Committee, the Rules and Executive Nominations Committee, the Legislative Policy Committee, the Joint Federal Action Oversight Committee and the Administrative, Executive and Legislative Review Committee.
